scripts.check-deps: printf 'soffice:  ' && (command -v soffice >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK || echo 'MISSING — brew install --cask libreoffice') && printf 'pdftoppm: ' && (command -v pdftoppm >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK || echo 'MISSING — brew install poppler')
scripts.install-deps: brew install --cask libreoffice && brew install poppler
